theorems.name: Submission.coareaJacobian_eq_zero_iff_not_surjective
theorems.statement: ∀ (N m n : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m) (x : Rn N) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N), tangentSpace M x = LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap → (coareaJacobian M f x = 0 ↔ ¬ Function.Surjective ((fderiv ℝ f x).comp A))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
